subject: PERFORM statement
notes: kb/Work/PB440.md - LANDED. The two arms the row's previous verdict rested on are fixed at the ROOT: a resolved procedure range is now a PcRange that CARRIES its emptiness (it cannot be derived - a zero-paragraph section, 14.4.2, and an ADJACENT inverted THRU range, GR6, are the identical pair (s, s-1)), BindPerform has ONE path that always binds the control phrase, EmitOutOfLinePerform emits the control-phrase scaffold for EVERY range and supplies an EMPTY body when the set is empty, and DispatchState.DispatchCall is the one place a range becomes __Dispatch and THROWS on an empty one. The ONCE half is structural (EmitPerformLoop's default arm emits the out-of-line body unconditionally, with no loop). The SET half is what was wrong and is now measured: over the empty THRU composition the basic PERFORM executes an EMPTY set once, so pb440_perform_empty_range reads PLAIN N=0 and THRUBASIC N=0 at all four editions - before the fix THRUBASIC read N=1, the FOLLOWING section's statement, which is not the specified set at all. The non-empty basic form is pinned by pb440_perform_range_composition (PARATHRU N=0007, SECTION N=0030).
